title: 2026: An Indian-origin engineer is about to run Adobe for the second time in a row.

sources.text: Adobe official newsroom, September 3, 2026 - Adobe Announces Anil Chakravarthy to Become President and CEO
CNBC, September 3, 2026 - Adobe names Anil Chakravarthy as CEO, replacing Shantanu Narayen

caption:
2026: An Indian-origin engineer is about to run Adobe for the second time in a row.

Adobe's board has named Chakravarthy - a B.Tech graduate of IIT (BHU) Varanasi who moved to the US at 21 for MIT - as the company's next President and CEO. He succeeds Shantanu Narayen, himself Indian-origin, who becomes Executive Chair. The handoff, announced September 3, 2026, takes effect December 1, 2026.

Chakravarthy joined Adobe in 2020, built its Customer Experience business past $1 billion in quarterly revenue and led the acquisitions of Workfront and Semrush. He'll now steer a company with roughly 31,000 employees worldwide - with Narayen's own nearly two-decade run at the top making this the second consecutive Indian-origin CEO at Adobe.

As India's engineering pipeline keeps feeding the world's largest software companies, Viksit Bharat 2047 isn't just about what India builds at home - it's about the systems India-trained minds now run everywhere.
